title: access audit
description: view and audit all access memberships across users and groups

info.title: Access Audit Overview
info.description: The Access Audit page gives a complete view of every membership in your organization — who (a user or group) holds which role, in which organization. Use it to review and audit access.

memberships.title: Memberships
memberships.text: View every access grant linking a user or group to an organization with a specific role

users.title: User Access
users.text: Filter by user to see all organizations and roles assigned to that user

groups.title: Group Access
groups.text: Filter by group to see all organizations and roles assigned to that group

scope.title: Access Scope
scope.text: See each grant's scope: 'local' applies to the organization only; 'recursive' cascades to its child organizations

empty.title: no memberships found
empty.description: there are no memberships matching your filters. Try adjusting the filters or check if memberships have been created.
